items.title: Bill Mays interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 5, 2025
items.q: Howard Rumsey and the Lighthouse All- Stars... I loved what I heard

ctx.x: When you were in your teens, after the banjo experience, did you have a choice of what you were going to do with your life? Did you have something to decide? © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

Yeah. Miles Davis and hearing Earl “Fatha” Hines live and also some pivotal records that I heard at around this same time, age 14, 15 – Howard Rumsey and the Lighthouse All- Stars, Charlie Ventura, Vido Musso, a lot of saxophonists now when I think of it. Brubeck, Desmond. I loved what I heard and I knew somehow I wanted to do it. I didn’t know what that meant but I took every opportunity to play music with other people as it arose. And I took every little gig that was offered, something that I did in the early…
Yes, “slide with the situation.” I like that.
